Name: GARAGE_CUTSCENE_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the handling of garage cutscenes.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Default Starting Cutscene
Fields.Description: The generic cutscene for the first half of the sortie when starting a mission.

Fields.Name: Default Ending Cutscene
Fields.Description: The generic cutscene of the AC being carried back in after a mission ends.

Fields.Name: Default Shortened Return Cutscene
Fields.Description: The generic cutscene used when the return cutscene is skipped, for example when the mission fails.
